title: Prompting and Parsing
summary: This module provides tools for constructing prompts for language models and parsing their outputs into structured formats. It includes various prompt templates, output parsers, and text splitting strategies.

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.title: Prompt Templates
nodes.description: Classes and utilities for creating and managing prompts for language models, including string-based, chat-based, and few-shot templates.

nodes.label: Output Parsers
nodes.title: Output Parsers
nodes.description: Tools for structuring language model responses into specific formats like lists, XML, JSON, or Pydantic objects, with error handling and retries.

nodes.label: Text Splitters
nodes.title: Text Splitters
nodes.description: Strategies for splitting text into smaller, manageable chunks while preserving semantic structure and metadata, including token-based, HTML-aware, and JSON-aware methods.

nodes.label: Language Models
nodes.title: Language Models
nodes.description: External module providing interfaces for various language models (LLMs) and chat models that consume prompts and produce raw outputs.

nodes.label: Data Handling
nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: External module for loading and managing documents, which can then be processed by text splitters.

groups.label: Input Preparation
groups.title: Input Preparation
groups.description: Components responsible for preparing and structuring input for language models, including prompt construction and text segmentation.

groups.label: Output Processing
groups.title: Output Processing
groups.description: Components dedicated to interpreting and transforming raw language model outputs into usable, structured data.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Modules from other parts of the LangChain ecosystem that interact with prompting and parsing functionalities.
